name: Photo Review Presenter
description: Converts a scored capture and its resulting collection or commission changes into one normalized photo-review request. The model contains the capture reference, subject names, criterion breakdown, personal-best marker, and newly ready contracts, letting a renderer explain the result without recomputing gameplay rules. The presenter owns presentation intent only: it does not score, mutate collection records, store images, or render a platform-specific panel. Requests are deduplicated by capture id so duplicate collection events cannot stack duplicate review cards for the same shutter press.

inputs.name: maxSubjectChips
inputs.description: Maximum subject labels in the compact review model. Additional subjects remain available in subjectCount without crowding small screens.

inputs.name: showUnscoredCaptures
inputs.description: Whether a capture with no eligible subjects produces an explanatory review request. Off keeps free photo mode free of gameplay interruptions.

inputs.name: requestDedupeCacheSize
inputs.description: Bounded recent-capture id cache used to emit at most one review request per capture within a session.

outputs.name: reviewModel
outputs.description: Normalized capture reference, subjects, score breakdown, personal-best marker, contract-ready ids, and optional reason code.

outputs.name: lastPresentedCaptureId
outputs.description: Most recent capture converted into review intent.

provenance: Added 2026-10-29 with the Field Photography gameplay components (49ad258). Provenance written after the fact on 2026-10-29: it landed recording only "library-native". Nearest in a catalogue search: presentation.photo_mode, which takes the picture; this turns a scored capture and its collection changes into one review request and scores nothing. Library-native.
